3910.title: Pi custom model discovery
3910.rootCauseOneLine: Original cause unknown; isolated native Pi catalogs initialize successfully, while missing configured auth hides the custom model without an HTTP handshake.
3910.proposedFix: Collect sanitized configuration, provider identity, versions and startup errors before considering a code change.
3910.caveats: No original GGUF inference or external ACP bridge tested; second run verifies only the bounded negative finding.
